column4: Store createTag/updateTag enforce {type,topic,flag} allowlist; all three chip sites esc(kind). Tests: tests/store.test.ts, web/review-security.test.cjs.
Client safeHref on overview/review links, openUrls http(s)-filtered; server review-info.ts rejects non-http(s). Tests: tests/review-info-publication.test.ts, web/review-security.test.cjs.
Static org buttons use replacing on-handlers; row listeners re-rendered per pass. Test: web/organization-handlers.test.cjs (source-text). Invite scope-editor listeners still stack (harmless).
Stacked listeners fixed. Each org action still awaits full hydrateOrganizationView (~21 GETs; 22 call sites, unchanged); api() caches only /api/defaults.
agent.output only patches live bubble; excluded from taskEvents/activity; renderMarkdown memoized (128 entries, FIFO). Test: web/stream-refresh.test.cjs.
refreshTask single-flight per task with trailing pass; view.updated now fetches view+widgets only (was 9). Test: web/task-refresh-coalescing.test.cjs.
refreshTask coalesced and event-scoped (2 GETs). openTask still issues ~12 requests, unchanged, and j/k calls it per key without debounce.

projectId added; foreign-project events ignored. Only sibling attempts in S.attemptGroup skipped: on list page, non-principal attempt view.updated still reloads list. Test: web/event-routing.test.cjs.

Server stamps projectId on socket events; client ignores foreign-project list/search reloads; inbox reloads filtered by inboxEventChanges. Tests: tests/gateway-public.test.ts, web/event-routing.test.cjs.
inboxEventChanges reloads only for done/failed/cancelled, human waits, or tasks already in inbox. Test: web/event-routing.test.cjs.
renderRail() removed from connectWs and refreshTasks; remaining callers are navigation/user actions. Test: web/event-routing.test.cjs (source-text).
api() shares identical in-flight GETs; defaults cached 10s, user-scoped, cleared on writes. Test: web/request-sharing.test.cjs. No page-level request-count test.
Defaults cached and concurrent reads shared. loadCollaboration still runs twice on org switch (applyRoute app.js:548, then hydrateOrganizationView :17666, sequential).
applyRoute skips the second renderMain for cached same-project non-task tabs, so settings hydrate once. Test: web/list-repaint.test.cjs (source-text).
Patched view.updated now runs a background search and paints once after the result; no stale pre-search renders. Test: web/list-repaint.test.cjs.
All four project hydrators guard with renderIsCurrent and query only their captured box after await. Test: web/project-settings-scope.test.cjs (source-text).
readResponder uses readAgentSpec (MCP kept); selected Avatar saved as avatar:<id> audience route. Test: web/responder-roundtrip.test.cjs.
renderOnboarding skips unchanged markup via render key; polling stops when minimized, closed or hidden. Tests: web/onboarding-stability.test.cjs, web/background-work.test.cjs.
CSS hides .hosted-onboarding while #tf-page (task form) or .ck-compose (composer) is present. Test: web/onboarding-stability.test.cjs (CSS text).
pollOnboarding returns early when minimized/closed/hidden; expanding re-renders and resumes polling. Test: web/background-work.test.cjs.
Hidden tabs mark socket events stale and backfill once on visibilitychange; revision check, host-diag/proc polling and onboarding skip hidden tabs. Test: web/background-work.test.cjs.
Revision change shows a once-per-revision Reload toast; no automatic reload; hidden tabs skip checks. Test: web/revision-drafts.test.cjs.
Org GitHub pane and global search now show retry. Project Access still maps failed git-connections/github-app to setup guidance (app.js:13505); loadCollaboration still empties failures (:2929).
MathJax entry SRI and external SW script done. Console CSP still only frame-ancestors (static-assets.ts:42), deferred per 2b023505; MathJax ui/safe loads unpinned.

Palette/search/help/action forms use transient #modal-root roots, preserving the task form. Attempt dialog (app.js:10541) still uses #overlay-root, unreachable with form open. Test: web/overlay-preservation.test.cjs.
Client and store slugify keep NFC-normalized Unicode letters/numbers/marks, so distinct non-ASCII names stay distinct. Tests: tests/store.test.ts, web/unicode-slugs.test.cjs.
Profile and organization GitHub removal both confirm with a repository-access warning before DELETE. Test: web/github-disconnect.test.cjs.
--ink-3 now #626e7e light / #929dad dark: 4.84-6.77:1 on paper/surface/surface-2 (recomputed). Test: web/contrast.test.cjs.

REGRESSION? /api/search loops every installation project, minting per-project session tokens (server.ts:8582-8584,:8642). Mark-read batched per org. Tests: tests/gateway-search.test.ts, tests/inbox.test.ts.
REGRESSION? Server search walks all tenants' projects, each auth() minting a stored token for cookie users (server.ts:8582-8584,:8642). Client: one aborted, debounced, 2-char request.
rememberInteractionOrigin ignores keydown from inputs/textareas/contenteditable, so keyboard sends no longer mark the textarea pending. Test: web/text-action-feedback.test.cjs.
Shell listeners installed once; connectWs retires prior socket and retry timer; shared read cache keyed by user. Test: web/relogin.test.cjs.
Vault item policy selects now revert and lock during save. Cited conversation-sharing policy select (HEAD app.js:13078) still keeps rejected value after failed save; unchanged.
Tags manager captures new-tag and active edit-tag fields before redraw and restores them; clears only after matching save. Tests: web/tag-draft.test.cjs, web/console-journeys.browser.test.cjs.
parseRoute and wiki hash use decodeRoutePart (literal on malformed escapes); remaining decodeURI calls wrapped in try. Test: web/malformed-route.test.cjs.
All three PR link sites (pullRequestLinks, checkoutsSection, insightTaskRow) now pass URLs through safeHref. Test: web/review-security.test.cjs.
forkCommandFor single-quotes path, config home and session id with POSIX escaping for both providers. Test: web/fork-shell-quoting.test.cjs.
refreshTask on 404 drops the task from S.tasks, toasts 'This task was deleted' and closes the page. Test: web/deleted-task.test.cjs.
qr-scanner script removed from index.html; totp-qr.js loads it lazily on first pasted image, retryable on error. Test: tests/vault-totp-ui.test.ts.
qr-scanner now lazy. Boot unchanged since d5190e7e: meta, launch, session, orgs/projects, collaboration/schema/onboarding still sequential before renderShell (app.js:2730-2846).
Payments section wired once per live key; spend refreshed only on spend./payment. events or full refresh. Test: web/background-work.test.cjs.
Inventory cached per stage, invalidated by review.updated/resource.* events; no 15s TTL refetch on refreshTask. Test: web/background-work.test.cjs.
S.activity now kept only on Activity tab for current project. Server still pushes every readable project's events, including agent.output, to every tab (no /ws subscription).
Only confirmer/responder help (:1265,:1268) moved to tips. Seven cited paragraphs unchanged inline: checkouts, project Data/Services, vault requests, notifications x2, org network, usage policy.
Dead hydrateProjectResources resource editor removed (0 references at HEAD). Test: web/console-cleanup.test.cjs.
Stray task-form replaced with ; footer tags now balanced (2 open, 2 close). Test: web/console-cleanup.test.cjs.
Three Work-locally modals (openLocalCheckout, openProjectCheckout, materializeLocalCheckout, app.js:9472,:9521,:9549) byte-identical to base; 3a9598b2 says UI-33 partial.
refreshTask(v.taskId) replaced by refreshTask(); no argument-passing calls remain besides ev.type reasons. Test: web/console-cleanup.test.cjs.
Each confirmer/responder audience input gets a unique generated datalist id; no literal #human-audience-options remains. Test: web/console-cleanup.test.cjs.
parseRoute still repeats the project tab list ['tasks','queue','activity','wiki','avatars','settings'] twice (app.js:372,:389).
llms.txt gains 'Agent entry points': platform MCP, describe_platform, platform_request, connection tools. Test: web/console-cleanup.test.cjs.
'Return to Tavya' now uses siteNameMarkup(). Still drifting: globalThis.TavyaMarkdown (markdown.js:344), 'Krmax' in index.html:10/app.webmanifest vs 'krmax' title.
All 10 native prompt() calls now use escaped in-page promptText dialog with focus restore; remaining confirm() are yes/no only. web/text-prompt.browser.test.cjs.
List, draft and inbox task rows get role=group + escaped aria-label (web/task-row-accessibility.test.cjs, source-text). Queue-view task rows (.queue-item, app.js:10891,10912,10931) still unnamed.
Full-shell Chromium journey on fake /api+WS added (web/console-journeys.browser.test.cjs), fixtures inline, not reusable. Web tests still mostly non-browser (91/109); pure source-text 7 to 20.
